title: slo.breached payload v1
description: A service level objective of config/registry/slo.json is outside its entry; evidence is the newest event the value was computed from, so replaying a log never emits it twice.

slo.description: Registry name of the SLO entry that was breached.

value.description: The measured value, in the unit of the registry entry.

limit.description: The entry's value that the measurement is compared with.

bound.description: max: the value may not exceed the limit; min: it may not fall below it.

samples.description: Number of samples the value was computed over.

evidence.description: event_id of the newest event the value was computed from.
